entry_conditions: Nominal cabinet calibration and any causally recognizable demonstrated phase from closed/high/free through open/front-release/red approach. Drawer progress, finger state and TCP/object relations must be physically coherent; phase prediction is not entry proof.
exit_conditions: Drawer_position safely above strict 0.26 m, near-zero drawer motion, front relinquished, and red closed upon with observable TCP/red upward co-motion for the nominal handoff.
overlap_role: All actions 0:470 remain supervised. The release/retreat, red approach, close and lift classes include every 230:470 overlap action shared with red_transfer, 2,880 overlap actions total.
successor_readiness: An early red_transfer switch is supported after drawer opening/red exposure at 230. The nominal stronger switch follows the close/lift phase when red and TCP co-move near 470.
failure_signatures: Actions inconsistent with drawer progress/finger state; drawer below threshold after pull; continued front drag; TCP/red misalignment; closure without red co-motion; drop during lift; or IK nonconvergence. A phase class is never physical proof.
continuation_guidance: Continue only while causal cues agree with one demonstrated successful phase. Use the 230:470 overlap to switch before or after release/contact. Replan on incoherent or unseen failure states rather than trusting the auxiliary classifier.
limitations: Guidance assumes nominal cabinet calibration and successful-occurrence phases. It adds no task-success condition, contact truth or recovery demonstration and does not cover displaced drawers, collisions or unreachable absolute targets.
